_comment: Repos this registry opened and found to be plugins wearing a skin's name: launchers, palette boards, skin *authoring* tools. awesome-dsh-plugins reads this file as a discovery lane (source: routed-from-themes) and will not route them back here by name. A row here is also in rejected.json with the reason; this file is the forwarding address, that one is the verdict.

repos.description: A visual, local-first skin authoring studio for DeepSeek Harness Web.
repos.note: a plugin, not a skin; belongs in awesome-dsh-plugins

repos.description: 2D Palette Board & Application Drawer for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): a Raycast/Launchpad-style floating application grid, with the paletteHub service open to all client plugins
repos.note: a plugin, not a skin; belongs in awesome-dsh-plugins

repos.description: DSH skin manager: a Skin row in Settings (native/skin-pack switching) plus discovery and persisted activation of dsh.skinpack packages.
repos.note: a skin *manager*, not a skin — it ships no stylesheet of its own; belongs in awesome-dsh-plugins

repos.description: A keyboard-first command palette for DeepSeek Harness sessions, workspaces, settings, features, and reusable custom commands.
repos.note: a plugin, not a skin; belongs in awesome-dsh-plugins

repos.description: Enhanced skill plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): fuzzy slash search, interactive multi-skill palette and preset bundles.
repos.note: a plugin, not a skin; belongs in awesome-dsh-plugins
